sidebar.submodules.inside.discard.body: All uncommitted changes and untracked files inside {path} will be moved into a stash named "{stash}" in the submodule. Applying that stash (open the submodule to see its stashes), or Undo in the submodule's tab while it is open, brings them back; dropping the stash deletes them permanently. The commit it is checked out at does not change.
sidebar.submodules.inside.discard.title: Discard changes inside {path}
sidebar.submodules.inside.discarded: Discarded the changes inside {path}; they are kept in its stash "{stash}".
sidebar.submodules.inside.head_failed: Could not read the branch of submodule {path}: {error}
sidebar.submodules.inside.not_checked_ou: Submodule {path} isn't checked out any more.
sidebar.submodules.inside.pull_detached: Pull needs a branch: {path} is on no branch (detached HEAD). Open it and check out a branch first.
sidebar.submodules.inside.pull_no_upstre: Pull needs an upstream: {path} is on {branch}, which has no upstream branch. Open it and set one first.
sidebar.submodules.record.tip: Stages the submodule's current commit in this repository. Changes inside it are not recorded; commit them in the submodule first.
